messages:
alexa-product: T-2h for EU slice launch. Posting stability gate + pinlist. Please ACK and flag any last-minute blockers.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v3.4.2 -> target: canary group (10% traffic). Canary channel: eu-west-1. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/3309991234
ben-ops: seeing small embedding latency blips earlier on eu-pool-2, but they smoothed out. Can we keep a 30m soft-freeze rather than full extend? @maria-sre
maria-sre: +1 on soft-freeze. Host CPU briefly spiked to 88% at 09:14 UTC due to batch jobs; autoscaler warmed new nodes and we dropped back to 45%. I'm tailing metrics and traces.
carla-release: We need precise rollback criteria in this thread. Proposal: rollback if p95 latency +25% vs baseline OR 5xx rate >1.5% sustained for 5m. Also block full rollout if canary error budget >0.75%. Thoughts?
sam-eng: Ack on those thresholds. Add token-cost regression guard: if avg per-token SSR (service-side reject) increases >10% we pause rollout.
alexa-product: Added to checklist: release notes uploaded (https://docs.redwood/release/v3.4.2), migration: NONE, feature flags: model-switch gating enabled. Do we have a pinlist to push to deploybot?
carla-release: Pushing pin list now:
```
pins:
  - service: text-gen
    version: v3.4.2
    model: redwood-open-llm-13b-quant
  - service: embed
    version: v3.4.2
    model: embed-redwood-2
```
Please confirm pinned components match deploy config.
deploy-bot: Received pin request. Applying pins to eu-west-1 staging lanes.
ben-ops: quick note: if we see redis latency >30ms simultaneously with model latency spike, that's a separate incident path — prefer unpin + quick fallback to v3.4.1 rather than full infra changes.
maria-sre: Noted. I've staged runbook steps for both rollback -> v3.4.1 and emergency-unpin. Runbook IDs: RB-3309 (rollback), UB-3310 (unpin). @carla-release please ensure on-call read.
carla-release: On-call ACO is @ben-ops for the window. I'm standing by for manual approve if deploy-bot signals pause. :thumbsup:
sam-eng: Suggest a Canary holdpoint at 25% so we can validate regression tests and smoke checks: perf, 5xx, cost, and trace sampling. If all green -> continue to 100% over 20m.
alexa-product: OK schedule: 10% -> 25% (hold) -> 50% -> 100%. Hold thresholds defined above. Documented in checklist.
deploy-bot: Canary -> 25% now (2026-03-21T12:03:00Z). Smoke tests running: smoke/gen: PASS, smoke/embed: PASS, perf p95: +6% (within threshold). Next check in 10m.
ben-ops: ACK, I see traces are sampling correctly. No anomaly spikes on infra metrics.
carla-release: Release notes link in the rollout message. Also adding a short customer notification blurb for Support.
sam-eng: One more: pin the kernel-optimization flag to ensure stable compilation path in prod: `KERNEL_MODE=stable-2026-03-19` — otherwise JIT might flip and cause perf noise.
deploy-bot: Applied kernel flag to canary lanes.
maria-sre: Observability: added dashboard watch with alert thresholds matching rollback policy. Alerts routed to #eng-oncall and sms to ben.
alexa-product: Perfect. Final checklist tick: release notes, pins applied, rollback runbook staged, canary holdpoints set, on-call assigned. Everyone acknowledge and we'll proceed as planned.
carla-release: ACK
ben-ops: ACK
sam-eng: ACK
maria-sre: ACK
deploy-bot: Canary -> 50% at 2026-03-21T12:13:20Z. Monitoring continues. Will post final 100% when safe.
